title: The Iberian Blackout Didn’t Stop the Energy Intelligence
summary: On April 28, 2025, a massive blackout affected over 55 million people across Spain and Portugal. While the grid collapsed, homes equipped with the Tigo EI Residential system continued to operate without interruption. Thanks to integrated solar production, energy storage, and automatic backup, these systems provided seamless power continuity. Real-life case studies in Barcelona and Tarragona highlight the effectiveness of smart battery modes and solar resilience. In an age of increasing grid instability, Tigo Energy’s all-in-one solution proves essential for true energy independence and peace of mind.
